meta_title: Crypto payments for Web3 projects & DAOs · Dynopay
meta_description: Accept crypto payments for your Web3 project or DAO with Dynopay. Non-custodial, 15+ cryptocurrencies, hosted checkout & API, fees from 1.5%. Start free.
h1: Accept crypto payments for your Web3 project or DAO
subheading: Dynopay gives Web3 teams and DAOs a non-custodial way to collect contributions, sell access, and receive Bitcoin, stablecoins, and 15+ cryptocurrencies directly to a wallet or treasury they control.
intro_paragraph: Web3 projects and DAOs live on-chain but still need a clean, compliant way to collect fiat-priced payments for memberships, mints, services, and contributions without handing custody to a processor. Dynopay is a non-custodial crypto payment gateway that settles straight to your wallet or multisig treasury. Take payments with a hosted checkout, a payment link, or the REST API across 15+ cryptocurrencies, price in USD while settling in the coin you choose, with fees from 1.5% down to 0.5% at scale, no chargebacks, and a free first payment.

features.title: Settle to your own wallet or treasury
features.description: Non-custodial by design: payments land directly in the wallet or multisig you control, so the DAO treasury never depends on a processor holding funds.

features.title: USD pricing, crypto settlement
features.description: Price memberships or services in dollars for clarity, and receive the exact cryptocurrency you want — including stablecoins for a treasury that isn't exposed to volatility.

features.title: Automate access with webhooks and API
features.description: Confirm a contribution on-chain and trigger a webhook to grant Discord roles, gated content, or allowlist spots — wired through a clean REST API.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, create a project profile, and add one payout wallet address (or treasury multisig) for settlement.
Generate a payment link or embed hosted checkout for memberships, mints, services, or contributions.
Contributors pay in their preferred cryptocurrency, your webhook grants access, and funds settle to your wallet within minutes.

faqs.question: Is Dynopay custodial? Where do DAO funds settle?
faqs.answer: Dynopay is non-custodial. Payments settle directly to the wallet or multisig treasury you control, so your project never depends on a third party holding its funds.

faqs.question: Can I price in USD but receive stablecoins?
faqs.answer: Yes. Price memberships or services in dollars and choose to receive stablecoins like USDT or USDC — keeping a dollar-pegged treasury balance — or any of the other supported coins.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies are supported?
faqs.answer: Dynopay supports 15+ cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, XRP, TRX, MATIC, and stablecoins such as USDT (ERC20, TRC20, Polygon), USDC (ERC20), and RLUSD.

faqs.question: Can I automate access or roles when a contribution confirms?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dynopay fires a webhook when a payment confirms on-chain, so you can grant Discord roles, unlock gated content, or update an allowlist automatically through the REST API.

faqs.question: What does Dynopay charge?
faqs.answer: Fees start at 1.5% plus one dollar per successful payment and drop to 0.5% as settled volume grows. No setup fees, no monthly fees, and your first payment is free.

cta_body: Sign up now and your first transaction is fee-free. Non-custodial settlement straight to the wallet or treasury you control.
